issue: Detached paper puppet parts and displaced bone overlays at scaled window sizes. Reproduced in the native player at 2560x1480; bone-length-only validation did not detect the rendering error.
fix: Project each virtual viewport once, then render after closing layout areas in a clipped unit-scale pixel pass. Parts and debug bones use the same coordinate space.

native_renderer.scope: Probe actual draw matrices at rotation pivots and bone-bound source tips; inspect native screenshots separately. Does not prove every pixel of every animation frame.
